description: Appuis Vélos is a dataset listed in Open platform of French public data, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Grand Autunois Morvan. The Grand Autunois Morvan has installed 71 bike racks throughout the Autun territory, the 4 proximity poles (Anost, Couches, Epinac, Etang sur Arroux), as well as La Tagnière, Uchon, La Grande Verrière, Château de Sully, Château de Couches. This mapping makes it possible to locate the bike supports on the territory. Coverage: Grand Autunois Morvan. The portal shows the English title as "Appuis Bicycles" (machine-translated by the portal). The publisher named on the listing is Grand Autunois Morvan. Its keywords include mobilite, mobilite-durable, velo. The listing shows 3 download or service links in KML, GPX, GEOJSON. The listing shows 2019-10-02 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is as linked on the portal listing (http://opendatacommons.org/licenses/odbl/summary/). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-plateforme-ouverte-des-donnees-publiques-francaises.
